region_methodology.required_regions: Normal-game acquisition regions come from the canonical recursive quest graph plus the current content-source locality when an unlock is not quest-only.
region_methodology.league_override: Official Equilibrium quest auto-completion can remove normal-game quest gates later. Keep that as a separate overlay instead of rewriting these base requirements.
region_methodology.empty_regions: An empty required_regions array means the prayer has no region gate beyond its normal level or default-book requirements.
region_methodology.working_locality: City of Um, Gate of Elidinis and Sanctum of Rebirth use the project's historical Catalyst Misthalin mapping until Equilibrium publishes a locality override.
region_methodology.daemonheim: Daemonheim is a confirmed hard Forinthry requirement in Equilibrium.
